#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstdint>

static const int64_t MOD = 998244353LL;
static const int64_t INV2 = 499122177LL;

int64_t pow_mod(int64_t a, int64_t e) {
    int64_t res = 1LL;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) {
            res = (res * a) % MOD;
        }
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64_t n, m, l, r;
    std::cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    int64_t totalCells = n * m;

    if (totalCells & 1) {
        std::cout << pow_mod(r - l + 1, totalCells) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int64_t even = r / 2 - (l - 1) / 2;
    int64_t odd = r - l + 1 - even;

    int64_t ans = (pow_mod(even + odd, totalCells) + pow_mod(even - odd, totalCells)) % MOD;
    ans = (ans * INV2) % MOD;

    std::cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
